chain_words.nuance: cold enough to make one feel uncomfortable
very cold, sometimes used figuratively for an unfriendly manner
so cold that water would turn to ice

explanation: These words all describe low temperature, from a pleasant coolness to a cold so extreme that it freezes.

usage_notes.difference: 'Cool' describes pleasant, mild coldness; 'freezing' describes an extreme cold that causes water to turn to ice.
